top_signals.title: Vietnamese coffee farmers ride China’s durian wave
top_signals.summary: The area dedicated to durian in the country, which trails only Brazil in coffee output, has soared more than fivefold to 200,000 hectares nationwide over the past decade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Meta- and Google-backed Indian telecom operator Jio Platforms gets regulatory nod for IPO
top_signals.summary: India's largest digital and telecom operator, Jio Platforms, got a regulatory nod for an IPO, but the National Stock Exchange, another mega issue, is still awaiting regulatory clearance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: The battle to build a global defense bank
top_signals.summary: Britain, Japan and other G7 countries so far declining to join has raised questions over whether the bank can achieve the triple-A credit rating it wants.
